profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hands-on Principal Software Engineer, Software/Solutions Architect, Intelligent Automation Leader with 20+ years of experience across multiple industries

•	Experience in the following industries: Defense, Healthcare, Finance, Retail, Construction, Energy, Entertainment, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Public (Federal and State), Games

•	Reported to C-suite on client-side while winning customer satisfaction awards. Grew accounts by more than 100% while personally interviewing and hiring resources

•	Software development online community leader who provides free online courses (huesoftllc.com)

•	Author of SimpleEarth virtual globe, jell.js and others (github.com/hmendoza2001)

•	One of five Technical Leads among 500+ engineers at HP CoE site

•	Member of the Board of Advisors, Department of Computer Science, The University of Texas at El Paso

•	Graduated cum laude from MBA at NMSU (Harvard Business School accredited program)

•	Develop indie web games with my son as a hobby using my own custom created game engine

positions.description: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Framework · Microservices · Azure DevOps · Kubernetes · Microsoft Azure · Python · Solution Architecture · PostgreSQL · Linux · Scrum · Software Engineering · Node.js · Agentic AI · Software Development · SQL · Git · .NET Core · RESTful WebServices · Agile Methodologies · Java · Databricks · Data Science · Terraform · Large Language Models (LLM) · Anthropic Claude · Azure Application Insights · C#

positions.title: Sr. Software Architect
positions.description:
•	As the Technical Lead for a mainframe migration effort for our clients at Washington State Department of Transportation, I designed an Integration Data Layer using Volatility-based Decomposition Architecture, C#, Angular, Vue.js, Azure SQL Database, Azure Functions, Azure App Service, Bicep, Azure App Config, Azure DevOps, REST APIs, and Scrum among others. I also interviewed and hired my own development team and led them to successful delivery while winning multiple awards from the client.

•	As the lead Solutions Architect for one of our main healthcare sector clients, I designed and led the implementation efforts for a Big Data Distribution Platform using Microservices Architecture, C#, Python, Angular, Azure SQL Database, API Gateway, Service Bus, Data Factory, Redis, Pulumi, Azure Functions, Azure App Service, Azure DevOps, REST APIs and Scrum among others. I was in charge of gathering the initial requirements from the stakeholders. I also interviewed and hired my own development and testing teams and led them to successful delivery while earning multiple kudos from the client.

•	Established coding standards, incorporated AI and the use of Copilot to accelerate delivery time, and provided multiple brown-bags for our Engineering Department.

•	Helped our sales pipeline by creating the technical solution on multiple RFPs and presenting them in front of our clients.

positions.title: Intelligent Automation Architect
positions.description:
•	As a direct report to the CIO on the client side I executed strategic modernization initiatives for one of our main manufacturing clients which involved discovering opportunities for automation, convincing stakeholders of the benefits of automation, implementing automations across multiple departments like finance, shipping and receiving and IT among others, using UiPath as the main automation platform.

•	As one of three architects responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and operations of the cloud-based Automation Platform service offered by the company, I designed and implemented the code that served as the glue to our distributed systems using Java, Go, Node.js, JavaScript, React, AWS, Azure, Automic, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Elastic, Splunk, CyberArk, Kafka, Jenkins, PostgreSQL, Lambda Functions, EC2, RDS, Linux and Unix among others.

•	Managed several offshore development and operations teams consisting of 10 or more resources each. Among the 3 architects we led a team of a total of 200 developers based in India.

•	I also architected our platform’s expansion efforts to simultaneously host components on both AWS and Azure, and implemented the necessary connections between both clouds.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer and Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	As one of five technical leads among 500+ engineers at the El Paso Center of Excellence I was responsible for establishing the roadmap for employee training, career development, and organizing hackathons among other things.

•	As a Senior Software Engineer, I was part of several high visibility projects like the internal cloud implementation for a major telecom company, and the recruit enrollment system for the U.S. Army using technologies like Java, Spring, Hibernate, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Oracle, REST APIs, and Linux among others.

•	Provided dozens of courses and brown-bags on multiple technology topics to our entire Software Engineering Department.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · Kubernetes · Software Project Management · Linux · Jenkins · Scrum · Software Engineering · HTML · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Software Development · SQL · Spring Framework · RESTful WebServices · Java · Qt · Mobile Applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead Software Engineer in multiple state-of-the-art military systems involving Real-time 3D Graphics, Real-time Digital Video Encoding/Decoding and Streaming, Real-time Hardware Control Systems, Missile and Air Defense Training and Simulation; using technologies like C, C++, Java, FORTRAN, Qt, OpenGL, DirectX, SDL, and SQL among others.

•	Implemented coding standards and CMMI practices across entire Engineering Departments.

•	Mentored many of my colleagues and provided brown-bags on subjects like OOP, Design Patterns, Software Architecture, Systems Architecture and language and library features in C++ among others.
